name: Heterogeneous broadcast
description: Broadcast one read-only request across provider adapters and synthesize all correlated results.

variants.description: Exercise two-provider and four-provider topology matrices with deterministic adapter stubs.
setup: Create four deterministic provider stubs with distinct provider IDs and a common structured-response protocol.
Create a run-owned workspace group and start the completion listener before launching any stub.
exercise: Run a two-provider side-by-side broadcast, then a four-provider 2x2 broadcast, using the same request ID and nonce in each matrix.
Collect exactly one result per launched provider and synthesize the declared agreement field.

assertions.expectation: Each surface is mapped to the expected distinct provider ID and stable run ownership record.
Every provider receives the same normalized request ID, nonce, and payload.
The synthesis names every launched provider and includes exactly one correlated result from each.
Both topology matrices leave no run-owned surfaces or processes.

cleanup: Stop all stubs using the run-scoped token and close resources recorded in the ledger.
Remove fixtures and confirm unrelated Cmux resources match the baseline.

variants.description: Run a read-only two-provider smoke test and, when all providers are installed, an optional four-provider matrix.
setup: Discover installed providers, require at least two, and create a secret-free disposable repository with read-only permissions.
Allocate one run-owned surface per selected provider and activate correlated completion listeners before launch.
exercise: Broadcast one bounded read-only repository question with a required JSON artifact contract to every selected provider.
Collect results only after correlated completion and synthesize agreement without scoring exact wording.

assertions.expectation: Every selected provider becomes ready before the broadcast deadline.
The final synthesis cites one nonce-tagged structured artifact from every selected provider.
No provider modifies the disposable repository.
No broad .env file is injected and no credential value appears in evidence.
All live provider processes and run-owned Cmux resources are removed.

cleanup: Gracefully stop each selected provider and close only its owned surface on timeout.
Delete the disposable repository and compare the post-run tree with the baseline.
